    § 02 · The Method

    Designed to train, test, and transform.

    STRATA is built on the conviction that mining fluency is a strategic capability — not a technical footnote. Every module pairs business-English precision with operational judgment, geological literacy, and the professional clarity that defines premium mining leaders.

    01

    Premium Curriculum

    One hundred modules covering every domain of modern mining — from the foundations of exploration and surface mining to AI-powered extraction and autonomous equipment.

    02

    Realistic Scenarios

    Every MCQ is rooted in plausible professional situations — safety inspections, site audits, contract negotiations, emergency response — written for international mining professionals.

    03

    Automatic Grading

    Instant scoring with tiered performance feedback — from foundational to executive fluency — plus the vocabulary and strategic insight earned from each module.

    04

    Progress That Tracks

    Your completion and scores are tracked live as you move through the program. Revisit your strongest topics anytime in this session, or retake a module to refine your fluency.

    § 03 · The Author

    Brice Gadou

    Business English Expert

    Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. STRATA reflects his vision: mining fluency as strategic capability — a multiplier of trust, clarity, and operational credibility.

    Designed for the mining engineers, site leads, and operations leaders shaping how the world's resources are responsibly extracted — STRATA is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to communicate in the discipline most responsible for turning geology into genuine value.
